description: Library text that itself holds a COPY statement (§2002:7.1.2.3 GR14: "If the REPLACING phrase is not specified, the library text may contain a COPY statement that does not include a REPLACING phrase"). ANSI X3.23b-1993 added to ANSI X3.23-1985 XII.2.4 a general rule 12 (§1985:XII.2.4 GR12: "The text produced as a result of the complete processing of a COPY statement must not contain a COPY statement"); ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 39 lists the nesting as a 2002 addition ("The ability to nest COPY statements is provided"). The introduction gate is CopyProcessor.ResolveOneCopy, reported at the OUTER COPY statement the library text belongs to (kb/Work PB5126).
display: library text that contains a COPY statement
